gui.trashcan.delete.tooltip: Permanently deletes everything in the trash can (%s items).
gui.trashcan.delete.confirm.tooltip: Click again to confirm – the items will be gone for good.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.trashcan: Adds a trash can: a container with the same interface as a chest, plus a button that permanently deletes everything inside.
config.trashcan.title: Trash Can Settings
config.trashcan.ui.remote: You are playing on a server: the delete button settings apply here too, the deleting settings only to your own worlds – the server uses its own config/trashcan.json.
config.trashcan.ui.map_hint: One entry per line: key = value
config.trashcan.ui.invalid: Some values are invalid (shown in red).
config.trashcan.ui.discard.title: Discard changes?
config.trashcan.ui.discard.message: Your changes to the settings have not been saved.
config.trashcan.requireConfirmation.tool: The first click on "Delete" only turns the button into "Sure?"; a second click deletes. Off: the first click deletes right away. Read by your own game, so every player decides this for themselves – also on servers.
config.trashcan.confirmSeconds.tooltip: How long "Sure?" waits for the second click before the button goes back to "Delete". Read by your own game.
config.trashcan.deleteOnClose.tooltip: Deletes the contents automatically when the last player closes the trash can. Hoppers can still fill it, and nothing is deleted while somebody has it open. Read by the world: your settings in singleplayer, the server's on a server.
config.trashcan.deleteEffects.tooltip: Smoke and a hiss when a trash can is emptied. Read by the world.
config.trashcan.logDeletions.tooltip: Writes every deletion to the log, with the player, the number of items and the position. Read by the world.
